reviews.text: TOMMIE Michelle has been grooming, my standard poodle and my Bernese mountain dog for years. She listens to exactly what I want and gives me a beautiful groom. My dogs are never stressed.

We moved away from Houston 5 years ago to a small town.  We took all of our dogs to Groomingdales for years...Even after 5 years here and trying several groomers that would take new clients, every time I take my dogs to be groomed here,  I end up regretting that we don't still have Groomingdales. They were all so friendly, and actually cared that our dogs looked good when we picked them up.  At Groomingdales our dogs never came out with cuts and sometimes, acting lifeless for the rest of the day.  And when dropping them off, they never acted like they didn't want to be there, clawing at my legs to express their discontent.  Groomingdales was the best...we loved them.
Thank you for caring for my fur baby!!! Kind and trusting 🫶🏽

The original owner (Theresa) of Groomingdales has taken back over the business. I have used this owner since the 80s over many dogs, mostly Lhasa Apsos but stopped when new owners took over a few yrs ago.
My Lhasa was groomed there yesterday by Missy and she did a fabulous job. They are in the process of remodeling and things are a bit messy but my dog was treated very well and he was groomed in a timely manner. I’m so happy that Theresa has taken the business back under her ownership.
Absolutely sent from above, they got patience with my doggo and are extremely helpful and respectful. Would choose them over any other pet grooming services any day any time ✊️😤💙 …

Absolutely love how Michelle grooms my fur baby. She is very patient and loving with him too. I highly recommend this place. The owner is working on the aesthetics of the place but she is the absolute best
I have been going on a regular basis for grooming and even just baths. Pricing is great and always leave my dog amazing! Highly recommended
Excellent customer service!
Great service and so professional.

They are extremely polite and understanding. This was my first time trying another grooming salon out since moving to Katy. They did a great job at cutting my dog’s hair! I really liked how they kept me updated on how she was doing.
Top Notch Service!!!
They are great here. They are so good and caring.
The best in town, even my dog loves it.

I would not recommend this groomer. I set an appointment on Friday for Saturday morning, got pushed back 3 times, then was told to bring her Sunday, get here and no one is here! It says closed. Very disappointing. We came from out of town and stayed longer than planned to get our dog groomed and got our time wasted. Do not understand why we were told to come on a day they are closed. Come to find out another customer was told Sunday as well.
Excellent

The people here are great! They always do what they think is best for the dog & they make sure to call the owner to get permission to do something different than what they talked about when dropping the dogs off. And the prices are pretty good too!
First time. Won't go anywhere else

I recently had the pleasure of visiting Groomingdales, and I can confidently say it’s hands down the best grooming experience I’ve ever had. From the moment I walked in, the team made me feel welcomed, and it was clear that customer satisfaction is their top priority. The staff is not only incredibly skilled but also incredibly passionate about what they do. They took the time to listen to my preferences and concerns, ensuring my pet’s grooming experience was stress-free and tailored specifically to their needs.

What really sets Groomingdales apart is the level of attention to detail. They go above and beyond, offering services that I haven’t found elsewhere—everything from breed-specific cuts to personalized aftercare tips. It’s evident that they genuinely care about the health and well-being of each animal they groom. My Dogs are left looking not just clean and fresh, but truly pampered.

They are part of my life and have been for over 20years . Currently I have a senior dog who has been coming here and they are super patient with him and do an excellent groom, white poodle, my YORKIE is high maintenance and they both LOVE coming here and get so excited. Price is very affordable.
I also bring our pit bull and bull dogs to get bath and trims . I LOVE Missy and her Team!
Easy experience, and relatively inexpensive. The Manager, Missy, is really great!
They always do a great job with my pup!
Have been taking my Dawgs here for over a decade & have had ZERO issues, nothing but great cuts, clean good smelling dawgs coming home
Thank you to the staff for making our babies look great after being groomed. A special shoutout to Missy for your expertise.
I do not recommend this place... the first time they hurt his nose and this time they did the same thing again and hurt his eyes. They should be more careful with pets and not hurt them.

I highly advise NOT using this groomer unless you're okay with your pets spending the entire day in a crate.

While they are skilled groomers, their customer service is inconsiderate and inhumane, so I'm only giving them two stars.

They operate without appointments and expect pet owners to drop off their pets between 8 AM and 12 PM, grooming them in the order of drop-off. I dropped off my two small dogs at 10 AM, and they endured a grueling seven hours in a crate.

It was 6:30 PM before my dogs were ready, and I was able to pick them up. When I arrived, she was still grooming other dogs.

When I asked about the delay, the groomer explained that she was overwhelmed because so many dogs had been dropped off, she was working alone, and some clients wanted early pickups. This could have meant that my dogs could have been seen much earlier.

When I suggested implementing an appointment system, she said she was working on it. She said the same thing two months ago. I also recommended capping the number of drop-offs to a reasonable level, to which she had no response.

This wasn't the first time this had happened, and despite her assurance that it wouldn't happen again, it did. Even though I was given a $20 discount, I refuse to subject my dogs to this experience again. Her drop-off system is inconsiderate and inhumane.

Boseman and I have been going to this groomers for 3 years now and he absolutely loves it. I have tried multiple different haircuts with my schnauzer and he look good everytime.  He also enjoys boarding with them Eventhou he misses his pops a lot.  Thank you

I dropped off my dog today and was very disappointed with the experience. I understand the business is under new management, but it felt extremely disorganized and chaotic. I’ve been coming here for years and used to love the old team! My dog's name is Sonson, and I always felt confident leaving him with the previous staff, knowing he was in good hands.

When I picked him up today, he had been given the wrong haircut—my dog is bald and looks like a little old man. It’s sad, and this is not at all what I expected. Unfortunately, I won’t be returning to this location.

The manager did refund me, thankfully, but I want to be transparent—I would not recommend coming here.
